title: touchmark delivery report
description: The report of touchmark plan and distribute (report/v1): the providers, every target with its outcome, and the estimated (plan) or actual (distribute) API writes. In plan an outcome means what distribute would do. A non-public target of a public hub is only counted: its entry has no path and no repository id.

command.description: The command that wrote the report.

dry_run.description: Set for distribute --dry-run: nothing was written, and outcomes and writes mean what distribute would do.

outcome.description: completed, or superseded when the hub's default branch had moved on and nothing was inspected or written.

strict.description: The run had --strict: blocked and deferred targets and an incomplete resolve exit with code 3.

assume_opt_in.description: plan --assume-opt-in: for this report only, every target without an opt-in file, or whose opt-in file is not a regular file or is too large, counts as opted in; one whose opt-in file says enabled: false stays opted out.

providers.description: The hub's providers, in hub.yml order.

targets.description: Every target, sorted by provider and path.

ops.description: Audit journal of every mutation distribute made; empty for plan.

warnings.description: Warnings about the run as a whole; warnings about one target are in the target.

summary.description: Targets per outcome, every outcome present.

cost.description: Writes per provider id (HTTP writes of the API and git pushes): estimated by plan, counted by distribute.

paths.description: What the pushes of a plan or a dry run change, by path across the targets: sensitive paths first, then deletions, updates, mode changes and additions, each by path.

operations.description: What each one-off operation does in a plan or a dry run: the entries of .touchmark/operations.yml in file order (recreate, forget_declines, allow_mass_close, adopt_unmarked), then the operation flags of a local run.

notes.description: Free-form remarks about the run, by name.

commit.description: Full commit id: 40 or 64 lowercase hex digits.

fingerprint.description: The hub's host and immutable repository id, e.g. github.com/712345678.

pr.description: The hub pull request plan ran on.

host.description: The provider's host, with a port when it has one.

write_check.description: What is known about the write account's access, e.g. "not checked".

resolve_complete.description: Every organisation and group of targets.yml was listed in full.

missing.description: Repositories targets.yml names that the platform does not know, as <provider>:<path>.

changes.description: The changes D holds, by action.

repo_id.description: The repository's immutable id on the platform.

key.description: Content key of the changes; absent when there are none.

packs.description: The packs the target gets, in layering order.

opt_in_assumed.description: The target was processed as if it had an empty opt-in file: it has none, or, with plan --assume-opt-in, one that is not a regular file or is too large. opt_in_assumed_by says why.

opt_in_assumed_by.description: Why opt_in_assumed is set: targets.yml (an entry with opt_in: assumed selects the target, for real) or --assume-opt-in (plan's flag, for the report only).

orphaned.description: Files a pack the target no longer gets shipped, still unchanged in the target.

writes.description: Writes for this target (HTTP writes of the API and git pushes): estimated by plan, counted by distribute.

allOf.description: A non-public target of a public hub is never named: its path and repository id are empty, and it has no pull request, content key, packs, orphaned files or warnings. Besides skipped:private-in-public-hub, such a target can have the outcome of the sweep that closes a pull request of touchmark's in it (closed, blocked, deferred or failed). Every other target has a path and a repository id.
A target skipped as private in a public hub is one the report does not name.

account.description: Login of the account that wrote.

kind.description: What the mutation did: a git push, a pull request created or edited, a comment, a branch deleted, a label created, or a step of an API commit (the commit, the refs moved, a stage ref deleted).

before.description: What the mutation replaced, e.g. the branch head before a push.

after.description: What the mutation left, e.g. the branch head after a push.

scope.description: The part of the fleet a plan in a hub pull request processed in full: every target (all), the targets whose final pack list holds a pack the pull request changes (packs), or none, when it changes only hub files no target receives (hub). The targets outside the scope are only counted.

reason.description: What decided the mode: --all, the files every target depends on that changed, or why the scope could not be computed.

packs.description: The packs the pull request changes.

processed.description: The targets the plan processed in full.

estimate.description: What the writes of a plan or a dry run take: per provider the writes and the time its write limits give them, and the runs the rollout needs under limits.max_new_prs_per_run.

new_prs.description: Pull requests the rollout opens, in this run and the next ones.

runs.description: Runs distribute needs to open them all: 0 when nothing is written, or when max_new_prs_per_run is 0 and some would open.

sensitive.description: The path matches a sensitive pattern (built-in or hub.yml's sensitive_paths) or is written executable.

targets.description: How many targets the change goes to.

flag.description: The operation is a flag of a local run, not an entry of operations.yml.

target.description: The entry's target as operations.yml writes it; absent for a target a public hub's report does not name.

pr.description: The pull request the entry names (forget_declines) or whose branch it rebuilds (recreate).

until.description: The last day the entry is in force: YYYY-MM-DD, UTC.

effect.description: applies: the entry changes what the run does; none: it is in force and changes nothing; expired: its date has passed; unknown: the run cannot tell (its target was not inspected).

providerEstimate.description: One provider's writes (HTTP writes of the API and git pushes) and the seconds its write limits give them.

writes.description: This run's writes by the git path: every push one write.

api_writes.description: This run's writes when every push that needs or may need a signature goes through the platform's API commit; absent when that changes nothing.

total_writes.description: The writes of every run the rollout needs, by the git path; absent when it fits one run.

sweep.description: The sweep of stale pull requests.

reason.description: Why the sweep did not run.
